summary: Credit Acceptance Corp. filed an 8-K reporting a $450M asset-backed non-recourse secured financing, conveying $562.6M in consumer loans to a trust that issued three classes of notes (Classes A, B, C) with interest rates from 4.65% to 5.28% and average lives up to 3.62 years. The financing revolves for 24 months then amortizes, expected cost ~5.2%, proceeds used to repay higher-cost debt. This is a routine debt securitization, not a special situation. No special situation event or corporate transaction is present.
